head_coach.name: Marcelo Bielsa
head_coach.play_style_summary: Aggressive, high-intensity pressing and immediate counter-pressing after turnovers. He implements energetic, vertical chaos focused on rapid transitions, width via natural-footed wingers, and absolute physical sacrifice with high-intensity off-the-ball movements.

key_players.name: Federico Valverde
key_players.performance_stats: In the 2025/2026 LaLiga season with Real Madrid, Valverde recorded 5 goals and 8 assists in 33 matches with an average rating of 7.6. He excelled in ball carrying, high-intensity pressing, and long-range shooting with a pass completion rate above 88%.

key_players.name: Darwin Núñez
key_players.performance_stats: In the 2025/2026 Saudi Pro League season with Al-Hilal, Núñez recorded 6 goals and 4 assists across 16 matches with an average rating of 7.38. He functions as a high-tempo pressing forward, creating high-intensity transitions and direct threats in the penalty area.

key_players.name: Manuel Ugarte
key_players.performance_stats: A crucial defensive mid anchor at Manchester United, registering an average of 3.4 tackles and 1.8 interceptions per game, along with a 91% pass accuracy rate, serving as the primary ball-winner.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Suffered a muscle strain and flu symptoms, forcing him to exit the national team camp on June 9, 2026, to return to Barcelona for treatment.
Sustained a grade two tear in his right calf and is recovering from a fractured right collarbone.
Sidelined with a cruciate ligament tear suffered in late March 2026.
Recovering from a serious hamstring injury sustained in January 2026.
